verdict.rationale: Codegen documents agents that analyze requirements from plain-language prompts to implement features and fix bugs. When enabled, agents present a structured plan of each implementation step, and they can create new tasks in Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com. However, the docs never show a plain-language feature or bug description being explicitly converted into a scoped implementation task or spec, and the plan step is a configurable behavior. Missing for 10: documented intent-to-scoped-task conversion (how scope, acceptance criteria and boundaries are derived), explicit linkage between plan generation and tracker task creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task

citations.quote: Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
Generate new tasks automatically based on development needs and project requirements
Update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues, and create new tasks.
